snippet.title: Mall Simulator Together Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your own shopping empire in Mall Simulator Together. Manage stores, customize your mall, hire staff, and play together with friends in online co-op. Expand your business, attract customers, and turn a small shopping center into a massive retail destination.

Wishlist now on Steam: 
store.steampowered.com/app/4594460/Mall_Simulator_Together/
